params.body:
What is thin, said where it is decided.

- **Curate, Trends waiting**: each proposed trend says how often it was seen on platforms ("Seen on platforms 1 time, too few to go on the site"). Below five, Put on the site is dimmed and disabled; the pipeline refuses it anyway (pipeline #264, which sends `observed`). Without that field (an older pipeline) nothing changes.
- **Curate, Posts and the desk**: a published piece with zero or one source reads "Thin: 1 source"; own work is left alone.

Build ok.
